aiDescription: Adds multiple new ship designs inspired by the vanilla art style, including the Vixen-class Missile Frigate, Puritan-class Light Destroyer, Eternity-class Light Destroyer, and Complex-class Battlecruiser. These ships feature updated sprites, improved performance, and compatibility with UNGP and expert mode rules. Some ships include new systems and mechanics, with visual enhancements when using GraphicsLib.
